seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: x x34, no_change x14, tags x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) A1/A2 moves y +-6, carrying blocks on the beam; the whole move cancels if a pushed chain would leave the colour-4 field.
Beam (arm) A4/A3 changes w by +-6. A hook is any block on the beam rows at x == tip-4, with no tag check; then every block fully on the beam follows the tip. An unhooked extend pushes the blocks in the swept strip; a blocked group means the beam slides alone.
Block A3 [arm] x/no_change: x when a hooked group follows the retract, no_change when nothing is hooked or the group is blocked. Clicks are full no-ops, so click position does not decide the outcome.
Tags: a hooked next becomes collected when it is alone on the beam. A collected block off the beam reverts to next, and the new next follows the legend x order. Legend centres turn 0 while collected.
HUD row: 3s = (n-1)//3, where n counts non-click actions. n is kept in a memo keyed by returned frames, with fallback 3*bars+1 (0 if no bars).
